source.stem: The diagram shows a quadrilateral on a 1 cm² grid.

parts.text: Write down the mathematical name of this quadrilateral. [1]
Work out the area of this quadrilateral. Give the units of your answer. [3]

hinge.title: Decide when a boundary side on a grid must be measured or estimated as a diagonal unit instead of counted as the same as a straight grid unit.

intelligence.enrichment: For an irregular or grid-drawn boundary, estimate or measure each boundary segment's own length; straight grid steps and diagonal segments can have different unit lengths, so perimeter may need separate straight and diagonal units.
